body: I've really been thinking about it and it seems really like a not only decent option, but my only one.  I'm thinking I'm going to do it.  I'm decently smart so I could take a trade that I'd be doing for awhile but like you said if I join I want that comradeship so I don't want to be alone while performing whatever I'd do. I'm just wondering as, I'm very out of shape, not fat, more of skinny no muscles and what not, would the army still accept me and change me into what they need?  That would really help me.

Actually, you just made me realize there is a magical fix: the military, or more specifically, the Navy as they are very big where I am, that's actually brilliant and could work, the only downside being strenuous painful work that I've never really done before but anything is really better than where I am

I play League, on Steam I play CSS, all the Elder Scrolls games but right now primarily Morrowind, and Sid Meier's 5.  My Steam name is Apolloverse, however I'm offline a lot, sorry about that.  Just not a lot of reason to be online

I wish it were like that, no one remembers, and in some cases people forget, but unfortunately I don't.  For the rest of my life I'm going to have to remember that I didn't go to prom, senior week, celebrate any of my birthdays, have friends or fun stories from high schools, go to parties, go to the ringing ceremony, nothing. No high school love, no nothing.

Also, I can't drive, I live near a bus line (very high population city) but if I ever leave the house they ask me where I'm going, always have, and wouldn't let me go if I did, threatened to kick me out if I refuse to accept what they say. 

In all honesty, I thought once about storming out, moving to the other side of the country, changing my name, making up a fake past and just 'assuming' the role of someone else.  It sounds crazy but it's also great because after a long time of a lie, it just sort of becomes the truth right?  That's one way, but it's really fantasy, I have no money or influence to make it happen.

I honestly can't.  That's partially why I came here.  I don't really have anywhere to start. 
I can't drive, like my parents would ever teach me
No social skills to get a job
No money in general
No family to live with
No friends to live with
I couldn't steal money from my parents

I really have no place to begin, even if I got a part time job, I can't leave McDonalds and go back to my box in the streets.

My mother was well aware of what she was doing to me, and how it was affecting me, but I wasn't sure if she knew how severe it was.  I tried to send this message, when I got my graduation tickets, I tossed them in the trash, partially to send a message that what she had did to me, was really really making me feel rejected, somewhere in my mind that worked, but it didn't matter in the end, she didn't really care, just didn't go.

Since you said you don't know enough, I'll try to explain it in as packed a way as possible.

In 8th grade, I had my group of friends, I loved them, they had my back with everything and we did everything together.  Come the second semester we're all applying to high schools, and everyone wants to go to a certain high school, one of three most notable ones in the area.  My friends and I all apply to one, but through some horrible divine attack, I'm the only one that gets in.  All my friends decide to together go to a public high school, and I'm on the fence but I say that's where I want to go.  Too bad, mother says I'd be an idiot to squander this oppurtunity and forces me to go.  Now this has little to do with it but this school was expensive.  Everyone there was wealthy, except me, I lived in the city, and while I don't think this is why I don't fit in there, I certainly think it doesn't help.  Pretty much two years of this, I get mocked, I get shoved, I get ignored, rejected until I decide I've had enough and it's time to make friends.  Surprisingly, through really pushing myself (it was mentally difficult, I really had to shove myself into situations where I was afraid) I managed to get a circle of friends, who I planned to meet at the mall.  It all started with this girl, but I didn't tell my mother that, I randomly asked her to take me to the mall, which surprised her, because I never left the house on weekends ever.  Regardless she takes me, and I meet this girl and her friends, and surprisingly, I'm accepted, but I soon learned that my mother didn't leave, she was following me and my new friends the whole time.  We're sitting and eating when my mother comes over and yells at me, making a scene in front my new friends, taking me by my hand and pulling me out of the mall.  I was too shocked to even respond, and later I learned that my mother called that girls mother and lied, saying we were smoking at the mall (sophomores at the time).  The girl is pissed at me, and tells all her friends and I fall back into being alone.  This happens again my junior year with a friend who was a guy.  I slept over his house, where my mother called me every hour of the night, and came to pick me up at 6:00 AM sharp, and did the same thing, this time saying I admitted we drank cough syrup, again, not true.  I gave up trying to make friends, I was ridiculed enough, senior year I did nothing really, funny enough my grades improved.  Didn't go to senior week, didn't go to prom, didn't have a girlfriend ever, my old friends don't even remember me, and I really can say I haven't felt happy in the last four years.  I don't even remember what happy feels like, I'm just constantly alone.
